decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
1/ The proposed erection of hip to gable roof and rear dormer extension with two roof lights on the front plane of the roof, would, unacceptably unbalance the appearance of this pair of semi detached houses and the rhythm of the roofscape in the street and  by reason of their disproportionate size, their position and appearance in relation to this and neighbouring properties and to the street scene, would be unduly obtrusive and be harmful to neighbours' outlook contrary to the Policies  ENV-B 1.1 (New Development)   and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations) of the  Unitary Development Plan and Supplementary Planning Guidance, Residential Extension Guidelines.     

2/ The drawings submitted for the existing and proposed development to the house are inaccurate and contradictory and as a result the size and position of the proposed extension within the roof area are not clear.   The Authority has no alternative but to refuse Planning Permission.
description: Erection of roof extensions to the side and rear roof slopes and the installation of two rooflights to the front roof slope of the house
